chapters.chapter_name: From House to Home Bonding the Family
content: Explore four ways to bond with their family - appreciation, meeting
on a regular basis, being helpful, and to have transparency when
communicating with each other.

chapters.chapter_name: Learning from Legends Leading without Leading
content: Explore a new approach to leadership, through humility.

chapters.chapter_name: My India My Pride Glorious Past Part-1
content: India's ancient Rishis, scholars and intellectuals have made
tremendous contributions to the world, they developed an advanced,
sophisticated culture and civilization which began thousands of
years ago. Students will learn the importance of studying India's
glorious past, so that they could develop a strong passion and pride
for our nation.

chapters.chapter_name: My India My Pride Glorious Past Part-2
content: Our ancient concepts can be used to seek revolutionary ideas and to
generate inspiration. Students will develop a deeper interest in
India's Glorious Past – by appreciating the need to read about it,
research it, write about it and share it.

chapters.chapter_name: My India My Pride Present Scenario
content: To implement the transformation of India from a developing
country into a developed country it is necessary to have a value-
based citizens. Students will see how the transformation to a greater
India relies on the vision and efforts of themselves as youth.

chapters.chapter_name: Remaking Yourself Begin with the End in Mind
content: Learn to visualize their future goals and will structure their life
through smart goals to give themselves direction and ultimately take
them to where they want to go.

chapters.chapter_name: My India My Pride An Ideal Citizen-1
content: Learn that to become value-based citizens, they must ?rst develop
good values in their lives. They start by focusing on these four:
responsibility, accountability, honesty, and integrity.

chapters.chapter_name: My India My Pride An Ideal Citizen-2
content: Learn that by developing the values of loyalty, sincerity and
punctuality; they become indispensable and can leave a strong
impression. They will start developing these values by trying to
keep perfection in every small task and by looking at the bigger
picture.
